notes: Advisor plan Phase 5B. Starter questions for an empty Chat conversation. Each lane names the account fact that makes a question worth asking (packages/core/src/resolvers/chat-starters.resolver.ts). {behavior} is filled with one of the person's own Behavior titles, so templates keep the person as the subject and work for verb-phrase titles too. min_behaviors hides a question until the account has that many active Behaviors. advice_card names the advice card a question draws on, when there is one. Copy rules (Emi's review, Nov 20): Behavior for the recurring habit, items for one day's instances, Needs decision for older items without a mark; no scorekeeping, guilt or cheerleading; every question answerable from the person's own record. Revision 2 applies that review.
